correctness.rationale: The bidegree-(4,3) vanishing ideal of all nine points of P1(F2)^2 has dimension 8+5-2=11. An independently built 11-vector GF2 kernel gives all 2047 nonzero sections. Recomputed geometric smoothness over the algebraic closure by Gröbner unit ideals (f,du f,dv f) on all four affine charts: exactly 364 rationally nonsingular and 66 geometrically smooth. Full independent comparison of all 2145 unordered smooth pairs gives exact 3:642,5:981,7:468,9:54 and 27 tangent patterns. A shared characteristic-two gradient sums to zero, forcing the third nonzero section of a pencil singular; smooth existence gives the sharp one-dimensional bound.
